import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.feature_selection import SelectKBest, f_classif
from sklearn.datasets import make_classification

# Generate classification dataset
X, y = make_classification(n_samples=200, n_features=10, n_informative=4, random_state=42)
feature_names = [f'feature_{i}' for i in range(10)]

# Apply SelectKBest with f_classif scoring to select top 4 features
selector = SelectKBest(score_func=f_classif, k=4)
X_selected = selector.fit_transform(X, y)

# Get the scores and p-values for each feature
scores_df = pd.DataFrame({
    'feature': feature_names,
    'f_score': selector.scores_,
    'p_value': selector.pvalues_,
    'selected': selector.get_support()
}).sort_values('f_score', ascending=False)

# Print the feature scores, p-values, and selection results
print("Feature Selection Results:")
print(scores_df.to_string(index=False))
print(f"\nSelected features: {selector.get_feature_names_out(feature_names).tolist()}")
